text: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Australia. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

result.keyword: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Australia. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

items.markdown:
For a $10M luxury property in Australia, top-tier agencies with proven high-end track records include Sotheby's International Realty, [Knight Frank Prestige](https://www.knightfrank.com.au/), Ray White Prestige, [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/) (Victoria), [Marshall White](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/) (Victoria), and [Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/) (Queensland). Selection depends heavily on your local property market.[[1]](https://www.salebyhomeowner.com.au/realestate/top-real-estate-agents-sydney-nsw/)

### National & International Luxury Specialists

- **Sotheby's International Realty** : Unmatched global database and affluent buyer reach across Sydney, Melbourne, and coastal lifestyle regions.[[1]](https://ultraprime.com.au/)[[2]](https://worthbury.com/magazine/best-real-estate-companies-world/)
- **[Knight Frank Prestige](https://www.knightfrank.com.au/)** : Strong international private-client network with deep connections to ultra-high-net-worth expat and overseas buyers.[[1]](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-luxury-residential-real-estate-market/companies)
- **Ray White Prestige** : Massive national footprint with specialized high-end offices handling top-tier metro and holiday-market estates.

### State & Regional Market Leaders

- **[Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)** : The benchmark for high-end heritage and contemporary luxury sales across Melbourne’s elite inner-suburbs.
- **[Marshall White](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/)** : Dominates high-value auction and private treaty campaigns across Melbourne.
- **[Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)** : Market leader for record-breaking multi-million dollar waterfront and luxury house sales on the Gold Coast.
- **Pillinger / Ken Jacobs / McGrath Prestige** : Elite boutique or specialized high-end divisions handling landmark trophy homes in Sydney's eastern suburbs and lower north shore.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)[[2]](https://ultraprime.com.au/)[[3]](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/australia-luxury-residential-real-estate-market/companies)

If you tell me the **city or region** where your property is located, I can give you the **exact top local agent** and office with the best record for $10M+ sales in that specific pocket.
